_readme: Your preferred 9jaLingo voice ID for each voice language (pcm = Pidgin and English, yo = Yoruba, ha = Hausa, ig = Igbo). Change an ID here, or override with the environment variables VOICE_SPEAKER_PCM / _YO / _HA / _IG in .env. If the server does not know an ID, the system falls back to a built-in default voice and reports it. Find and audition voices with: python voice_tool.py voices   and   python voice_tool.py audition
